note: Classical Sallusto/Lanzavecchia CD4 non-Treg memory layout on CCR7 × CD45RA. Strategy: (1) Naive_CD4 anchors on the dense blob at the upper-right corner (CCR7 very high, CD45RA high) — antigen-inexperienced naive helper T cells. (2) EMRA_CD4 sits immediately to the left of Naive_CD4 in the upper CD45RA band (rare in CD4) — terminally differentiated helper T cells. (3) In the lower CD45RA band (memory cells), CCR7 is bimodal — locate the left edge / shoulder of the CCR7+ peak (where density rises from background); CM_CD4 (central memory; lymph-node homing) sits at/right of this edge (includes the dense CCR7+ peak), EM_CD4 (effector memory) sits to its left. CCR7 (and sometimes CD45RA) can be trimodal in this panel, so density peaks — not fixed thresholds — anchor the gate. Memory subsets (CM, EM, EMRA) feed downstream Tfh annotation.
tips: CD4 non-Treg memory subsets (Sallusto/Lanzavecchia, CCR7 × CD45RA). Naive_CD4: CCR7+ CD45RA+. CM_CD4: CCR7+ CD45RA-. EM_CD4: CCR7- CD45RA-. EMRA_CD4: CCR7- CD45RA+. Tissue context: CM_CD4 is enriched in lymphoid tissues (Spleen, LN) due to CCR7-driven homing; non-lymphoid tissues are dominated by EM_CD4 and EMRA_CD4.
